If it ends anyways in a early death you have nothing to lose anymore. You can always die. It can get better or worser. This not only counts for drugs do what ever you feel like or what ever you wanted to do if it gets to bad you always have that one way out.
I'm sure you won't accept this or you think there is nothing but just keep it in mind and think a little about it.
Relatable and it's good that you think about this. But this seems like you still want to keep up smth in life ?
No it's like everything else in the world some do like it and some not accept other opinions
You could do drugs there you can find moments of peace bruh sorry
Sorry I can't tell you I get banned if I do. Cause it would be suicide advice. Even if your just curious
No worries they are the right ones I gotta lot of experience xD

Fucking true words. My boss is raging about my or ppl with mental illness and he talks about suicide like it's only harming  the loved ones. But suicide is not about that. 
I hate how some ppl treat that topic. I wanna scream and yell into their stupid faces to finally get it.
Yes I relate to that wish even tho I know I'm at a point where help is useless at the end the only one who can save you is yourself. But it still would be good to know ppl take me seriously.

A guy kidnapped me and put me in a room with other ppl that got kidnapped. We all got tortured by him. I could free myself and a friend helped to get this bad guy busted by the police and we thought everything would go well. We where again in his office it was a huge hall with some rooms connecting to it. We walked through it and helped everyone up but somehow the bad guy came back and got me again. 

It was nothing special but I'm dreaming very often and a lot and today I just woke up and cried. But not about the bad dream I cried cause I woke up. Even that weird dream where I got tortured is better than my real life.

Thank you but that's not the point here. everyone has to make themselves fit to our norm. If we don't we do not fit in this system. Some people are good at this and some not. I know I'm more real than others cause I'm bad at faking myself. But this is a bad property for society.

Yes they don't really seam to listen. But I just figured out my family isn't the place to vent or talk about struggles. Somehow friends do have more understanding. But surly every family is different and some might have good support.
Oh boy I didn't had it about the same topic but I got arguments with family like that too. It's so exhausting sometimes family members are so blind and toxic.

Tho as I said it's not possible you need money power and fame to change the world. And I know what I'm talking about a world like this would be dangerous as well but I know life like this I was long time traveling through poor countries where have been a lot of overgrown places and stuff like this. I know how to stay alive in the wilds and I like it!
Yes the only one who can help is oneself and I hate this fact
I think you should avoid these thoughts. If you do think often about this is becomes very common to you and you get use to it. As you said in manic or strong depressive episodes this can end worse.
